meta.name_zh: 醫療機構現況檔(1994-2024 年)
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 依當年底仍執業中之醫療機構（醫院及診所）年底現況資料編製。
2. 統計項目包含病床、醫事人員及非醫事人員、設備、診療科別等欄位。
3. 資料年度包含民國83年至113年。
meta.notes_zh:
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
1. 一家醫療機構（醫院或診所）為一筆資料。
2. 98年起增加評鑑等級(二) 「HG_2」欄位，若該醫院同時具兩種資格，則會將該
醫院新增的評鑑等級置於此欄。
meta.data_description_en: 1. Compiled based on end-of-year status data from practicing hospitals and clinics at the end of the year; 2. Statistical items include beds, healthcare personnel, non-medical staff, equipment, and diagnostic specialties; 3. Data years cover from ROC 83 to ROC 113.
meta.notes_en: Records the radiation dose to CTV_L in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. The unit of this field is centiGray (cGy), the same magnitude as the old unit rads. 00000: No external-beam radiotherapy, or external-beam radiotherapy given but no CTV_L; 00001-99996: Actual radiotherapy dose received; 99997: CTV_L external-beam dose is 99997 cGy or more; 99998: External-beam radiotherapy given but CTV_L dose unknown; 99999: Unknown / unclear whether external-beam radiotherapy was given.

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health13_醫療機構現況檔(20250624起適用)
meta.data_description_en:
1. Compiled based on the current status data of medical institutions (hospitals and clinics) practicing at the end of the year.
2. Statistical items include beds, medical and non-medical personnel, equipment, and departments.
3. Data years range from ROC 83 to 113.
meta.notes_en:
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
1. Each record represents one medical institution (hospital or clinic).
2. Starting in 2009 (ROC year 98), the accreditation-level (2) field "HG_2" was added; if a hospital holds two accreditation qualifications at the same time, its newly added accreditation level is placed in this field.
